summary: Capability-ranked ABI-2 backend providers now consume host-admitted checked HIR or serialized verified MIR and produce immutable staged artifacts.

Validated immutable target profiles, target feature constraints, data layouts, object formats, calling conventions, artifact metadata, SHA-256 identities, cancellation polling, reproducibility checks, and bounded output rollback are executable.
All five compiler-linked backends publish copied ABI-2 capabilities while retaining ABI-v1 names, statuses, command behavior, and public backend-run compatibility.

Toolchain providers are inert copied identities. A separate host resolver authorizes exact canonical absolute paths by driver, role, and SHA-256 without PATH lookup, file access, shell invocation, or execution.
Native instruction selection, assembly, object generation, linking, AOT, and JIT remain explicitly unsupported because MuLIB has no verified bridge from canonical On1x MIR.

facilities.subset: Copied provider/capability descriptors; phase, schema, artifact, target and feature matching; priority then target-specificity ranking; explicit-provider selection; ambiguity rejection; callback exception/status normalization; same-provider reentrancy rejection.
Immutable validated canonical target triples, CPUs, sorted unique feature sets, data layouts, object formats, calling conventions, equality, and feature queries.
Bounded private staging, no partial publication, owned immutable bytes and metadata, SHA-256, declared determinism, and optional two-run byte reproducibility checks.
c11, mir-c11, mir-cfg, mir-eval, and mir-text use canonical compiler implementations and advertise ABI-2 capabilities without changing existing on1xc modes.
Exact validated target matching, deterministic priority selection, ambiguity rejection, host allowlisted POSIX paths, role and digest binding, and owned relocatable inert resolution records.

blockers: MuLIB machine facilities consume a different native IR.
No canonical verified On1x-MIR legalization bridge exists.
MuLIB assembly still requires separately authorized external assembly/link steps.

tests.result: NON-BACKEND BASELINE LIMITATION: 100 passed, 3 failed, 1 skipped out of 104. Failures were on1x.type_checker_hardening_hir (configured LibStone Firestone unavailable), on1x.contracts (pre-existing MuLIB auxiliary inventory assertion), and on1x.mulib (pre-existing MuLIB fixture inventory assertion). All SDK/backend and compiler behavior tests passed.

Artifact publication or execution by backend providers

Opening, hashing, validating or executing host tool files inside the resolver

cross_owner_requests.request: Publish symbolic ABI-2 status constants for normative numeric values 8 through 16 in the core status header.
cross_owner_requests.reason: Backend polling preserves all nine ABI-2 statuses, but the frozen baseline exposes symbolic names only for ABI-v1 values 0 through 7.
cross_owner_requests.proposed_api: ON1X_SDK_CANCELLED=8, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED=9, STALE=10, CONFLICT=11, NOT_FOUND=12, INVALID_STATE=13, VERIFICATION_FAILED=14, CAPABILITY_DENIED=15, IO_ERROR=16 (final names owned by core).

cross_owner_requests.request: Expose an internal registry callback lease used by backend invocation so registry destruction/mutation can be deferred or rejected while a callback is active.
cross_owner_requests.reason: Backend code copies callback state and rejects same-provider reentry, but registry lifetime enforcement belongs to the shared registry implementation.
cross_owner_requests.proposed_api: On1xSDK_Status registry_callback_enter(const On1xSDK_Registry *) noexcept; void registry_callback_leave(const On1xSDK_Registry *) noexcept;

cross_owner_requests.request: Expose the admitted MIR envelope schema as an immutable program/snapshot query.
cross_owner_requests.reason: Backend matching currently derives the schema from the canonical serialized MIR prefix; a representation-owned query avoids duplicate envelope inspection.

cross_owner_requests.request: Add the new backend, target, artifact, native-probe and resolver headers to on1x/sdk/include/On1xSDK.h and merge this report into the capability matrix/inventory.
cross_owner_requests.reason: The umbrella header and shared capability records are principal-owned.
cross_owner_requests.proposed_api: Include the twelve headers listed in public_headers without changing their standalone C11 include paths.
